title: Comparison of parity-tuple and matching sums
statement: For natural numbers $n,k,q$ and a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the sum of the parity-tuple Fourier weights is at most $(k!)^{-q}$ times the sum of the matching-labeling Fourier weights. Here the first sum ranges over all $q$-tuples of size-$k$ subsets of an $n$-element set with empty symmetric difference, and the second ranges over all perfect matchings of the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part, equipped with compatible labels in the $n$-element set.
